fix(runtime): preserve pre-runtime leases on restart

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-51
  description: |-
    Preserve held runnable leases for selected, preparing, and prepared Attempts that have no dispatch or containment authority, so startup reconciliation does not force routine preparation into Recovery Required.
    
    Expose a bounded per-owner runnable-lease diagnostic projection and emit its release reason, reacquire outcome, and generation from scheduler diagnostics. Add PostgreSQL regression coverage for the pre-runtime startup matrix and persisted owner diagnostics.
